Organization.definition: An organized entity such as a company, institution, or association.

EducationalInstitution.definition: An organization that provides education, such as a university or school.

Location.definition: A geographic place or spatial area.

Settlement.definition: A populated place such as a city, town, or village.

FieldOfStudy.definition: An academic discipline or field of knowledge.

Occupation.definition: A role, profession, or position held by a person.

SportsTeam.definition: A group of athletes competing together.

Year.definition: A calendar year or point in time.

Type.definition: A class or category to which an entity belongs.
